moodGood.warm: Okay — a normal day load. You can fine-tune below in Settings.
moodGood.klar: Baseline: normal capacity. Adjust in Settings.

moodOk.warm: So-so: a bit less on the list, more time per thing. Not failure — adjustment.
moodOk.klar: Capacity reduced, times stretched. Planned that way.

moodHard.warm: A heavy day: deliberately little. More time per thing. Relief counts — not the list.

moodWithCarry.warm: {{base}} Below, {{count}} open item(s) wait — only take what fits today.
moodWithCarry.klar: {{base}} Carry: {{count}}. Only take what fits capacity.

carryMorning.warm: Good morning. {{count}} item(s) still open — take or leave. What is realistic today?
carryMorning.klar: Plan: review {{count}} carry. Then little and clear.

morning.warm: Good morning. What is realistic today — not ideal? Writing less is often braver.

morningSoft.warm: Good you’re here. No perfect day needed — an honest one is enough.

workFullHard.warm: Work capacity full — and that is exactly right today. Life tasks count separately.
workFullHard.klar: Points used up. No more work tasks.

workFull.warm: Work capacity full. No more today — life tasks count separately.
workFull.klar: Points used up. No more work tasks.

workTightHard.warm: Already tight — on a hard day, better stop here.

workTight.warm: Almost full. One large often replaces two mediums — not both.

lifeFull.warm: Life anchors are full. That is enough.

start.warm: Okay. Only this now: “{{title}}”. The rest waits on purpose.{{tail}}

checkInEnding.klar: Timebox almost empty: “{{title}}” — still on it?

checkInHard.warm: Quick check, no pressure: still on “{{title}}”?
checkInHard.klar: Status “{{title}}” — still on it? (Hard day: pause is fine.)

checkIn.warm: Quick check: still on “{{title}}”? Drifting is human.

hard.warm: Drifting happens — especially on hard days. Back to the one thing, or a deliberate pause. Both count.
hard.klar: Reorient: task or pause. No blame.

normal.warm: Happens. Back to the one thing — or a deliberate pause. No drama.

soft.warm: Good. Keep going — at your pace.

normal.warm: Good. Stay with the one thing.

hard.warm: Pause is especially okay today. When ready: start the timer again.

normal.warm: Pause is okay — not failure. When ready: start the timer again.

alone.warm: Done: “{{title}}”. Breathe — then the next if you want.
alone.klar: Finished: {{title}}. Continue only if you want.

overHard.warm: Timebox over. Marking done is enough — or one gentle extra round.

over.warm: Timebox over. Mark done — or start the timer again.

another.warm: One more timebox — only this one thing. Not the whole list.

zeroHard.warm: Nothing checked off — on a hard day that is not defeat. Smaller tomorrow.

zero.warm: Nothing checked off — and that is okay. Fresh and smaller tomorrow.

all.warm: All done ({{done}}). A good, realistic day.

partial.warm: {{done}} of {{total}} done. The rest may wait — it returns under “Still open”.
partial.klar: Done: {{done}}/{{total}}. Do not chase. Carry possible.

hint.warm: If “sleep on time” is on the list: now is a good moment to close the day.
hint.klar: Check sleep time. End the day.

parked.warm: Parked ({{count}}). Back to the task — ideas can wait without stealing you.

lockedEmpty.warm: You can always park ideas. Browse only after work tasks.
lockedEmpty.klar: Sparks: park yes, open after work.

locked.warm: {{count}} spark(s) waiting. Unlock after work tasks — life tasks do not unlock.

withSparks.warm: Life: “{{title}}”. {{count}} idea(s) wait patiently in the vault.

none.warm: Welcome back. No drama — continue when you like.

hard.warm: You’re back. “{{title}}” waits without blame. Timer was paused.

normal.warm: Welcome back. Continue with “{{title}}”? Timer was paused.

noLifeSparks.warm: Work done. {{count}} spark(s) are free — and the day may end.

noLife.warm: Work done. Sparks are free — and the day may end.

withLife.warm: Clock-out mode: work is done. Sparks free. {{count}} life anchor(s) left — no pressure.

capBlocked.warm: You already have enough small steps ready. Pull some onto today — or put things to rest. Then we can cut again.
capBlocked.kurz: Enough ready. Pull or rest first.
capBlocked.klar: Ready cap full. Pull or snooze/freeze — then cut again.

alreadySmall.warm: That bite is already small enough for one focus block. Better pull it — splitting further often creates micro-steps and stress.
alreadySmall.kurz: Already small enough. Pull instead of splitting.
alreadySmall.klar: Step is doable. Don’t split further — pull onto today.

tooFine.warm: That’s too fine (pen/open/click…). Prefer 2–3 doable steps of a few minutes — or you lose the thread.
tooFine.kurz: Too fine. 2–3 doable steps is enough.
tooFine.klar: Too micro. Only a few steps that stand alone.

tooMany.warm: Each split only 3–5 parts that cover everything — not 10 then trim. If one is still coarse, split that one later (or you get dozens).
tooMany.kurz: 3–5 parts, drop nothing. Finer later one by one.
tooMany.klar: Level: 3–5 complete. Don’t truncate; go one level deeper if needed.

emergency.warm: {{count}} item(s) with a near deadline — at the top of the drawer. No panic fire, just visibility.

radar.warm: {{count}} item(s) are on the radar soon — plan or cut when you have capacity.
